_comment: Box breakdown library. Add an entry per product bought or considered; build_all.py renders it into the Box breakdowns tab. Keep every claim sourced - if a figure is not verified, leave it out rather than guess.

boxes.name: 2025 Panini Prizm Draft Picks College Football — Mega Box
boxes.prices: Paid $69.99 + tax = $75.41 at Big 5 Upland · list is $55.99
guaranteed: 18 mega-box exclusives per box — Red Ice or Red Flash Prizms
typical: Inserts: Color Blast, Dual Color Blast, Manga, Stained Glass, Brilliance, Fearless, Hype, Instant Impact, New Recruits, On Campus, Prizm Break, Student Orientation, Trophy Hunting

chase.note: On the box art. The single biggest name in college football cards and the main reason this product sells.
Heisman winner, two-way player. Also on the box art.
Named among the top prospects in this checklist.
Mega-exclusive and serial numbered — the realistic ceiling in this box.

chase.p: /10 Gold, /5 Black Gold, Black Finite 1/1, Black Shimmer 1/1, Gold Vinyl 1/1
chase.note: The top of the parallel ladder. Long odds.

values: Cents. These trade as 300+ card bulk lots on eBay
Where the value actually sits — always pull these
18 per box, so they are common by design. Value is player-driven
notin: No NFL licensing. These are college uniforms and airbrushed versions, not NFL rookie cards
Colour Blast is effectively a case hit — do not expect one
boxes.verdict: The trap in this product is structural. Collegiate cards depreciate sharply once a player's official NFL-licensed rookies arrive — singles have been reported dropping as much as 40× against their NFL counterparts. 2025 NFL Prizm already released in February 2026, so that repricing has largely happened. On top of that, $75.41 all-in against a $55.99 list is a 35% premium. Open it for the fun; do not treat it as inventory.

boxes.name: 2025-26 Topps Signature Class NBA — Mega Box
guaranteed: Nothing meaningful. The name says Signature; the odds do not.

chase.note: 1:425. On a 10-pack box that is roughly one autograph every 40-odd boxes, about $2,700 of product.
Retail-exclusive to this Mega SKU — the only genuine reason it differs from any other box.

values: ~383,000 print run per card. Worthless by design
~15,000 — 25× scarcer, the only base worth keeping
notin: No guaranteed autograph despite the product name
boxes.verdict: The clearest example of a box priced above the expected value of its contents. If it appears at $64.99, the only question worth asking is whether it resells sealed above $65 — not what you might pull.

boxes.name: 2026 Topps Chrome Baseball — Mega Box
guaranteed: Mega-exclusive X-Fractor parallels — this SKU is their only home
typical: On-card autographs in the wider product

chase.note: Mega-box exclusive. The reason to buy this SKU over any other.

values: About $2.00 a card at $84 — reviews rate it well
boxes.verdict: The best-reviewed box in the case at the time of looking, and $79.99 is under what at least one collector paid. Second choice behind Prizm on brand, first choice on reviews.
